hypothesis: A completed UTC week's acceleration in Hacker News story links to an issuer's predeclared owned domains is a PIT proxy for developer adoption and product demand. Admitting the top three liquid issuers by weekly count minus the prior four-week mean, requiring at least two stories and positive acceleration, at the next regular-session open for a ten-session default-off paper hold should add cross-window alpha after costs.
next_retry_requires: an immutable as-published HN source that materially changes historical story membership
or at least 30 newly settled append-only forward issuer-week rows across at least 10 tickers
and a predeclared new gate shape rather than a threshold, lookback, top-k, hold, notional, or issuer-subset retune
notes: Gate2 and Gate3 passed with 158 settled trades across 24 tickers, but the formal 24% sleeve plus 76% core mix reduced aggregate EV by 2.1771 and PnL by $39,611.22; all three windows lost combined PnL, old_thin and late_strong also failed cash/SPY/QQQ replacement, and positive-PnL top5 concentration was 73.72%.

locked_variables: 5 bps entry and 5 bps exit slippage plus 35 bps round-trip cost
parameters.single_causal_variable: HN exact-owned-domain weekly attention acceleration top-3 next-open ten-session candidate pool v1

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retune the story-count floor, prior-week lookback, acceleration threshold, top-k, hold length, notional, issuer subset, or response function on this reconstructed Algolia archive.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Reopen only with an immutable as-published HN source that materially changes historical membership, or at least 30 new settled append-only forward issuer-week rows across at least 10 tickers under a predeclared different gate shape.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The source and mapping cleared the outcome-blind density contract, but weekly owned-domain attention did not identify issuers whose ten-session returns paid for capital displacement. Only mid_weak produced positive standalone sleeve PnL, while the capital-neutral combined portfolio lost PnL in all three windows; old_thin and late_strong also lagged cash, SPY, and QQQ replacement values.

prediction.confidence_reason: The outcome-blind preflight found 426/379/382 mapped issuer-weeks across 37/34/36 tickers with top-1 near 6.6%, and the fixed acceleration rule leaves 143/151/149 eligible issuer-weeks. Developer discussion can precede product adoption and demand, but HN attention can be negative or stale and the broad mega-cap map may produce high candidate overlap, so the pre-run probability is deliberately low.
